newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSBANK STRATEGIST NAZOS JOINS ABN AMRO.
newsitem.headline: XIOSBANK STRATEGIST NAZOS JOINS ABN AMRO.

text.p: Stathis Nazos, portfolio strategist and head of investment management at Xiosbank will join ABN AMRO as general manager of asset management, effective in April.
As head of ABN AMRO's asset management, Nazos, 40, will be responsible for the bank's mutual fund management subsidiary and its private banking unit.
Nazos, who has a M.A. in economics from the University of Chicago was a doctoral candidate before joining the financial markets in the U.S.
He was a portfolio strategist at Xiosbank for six years and since 1996 the head of investment management. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
